The Greenland diagram is expressly conceptual, not a new map calculation or a measured area ratio.
Both Python panels and the native HTML table preserve the inherited object-versus-encoding distinction and exact100049/400080 versus100000/100004 byte totals.
Both Docker states retain the assumed100MB earlier-layer payload; the later whiteout changes the merged view, and the one-RUN comparison stays limited to newly created temporary files.
The old gallery inventory is explicitly not used as a present-day completion claim. All four media are choices, not a promise of four completed outputs for each case.
visualFindings: Final full-page captures for both languages at1280/390px in light/dark themes were inspected for overall composition, hierarchy, section continuity and visible diagram/table placement.
Desktop skill and map columns have distinct reading order; narrow layouts become a single column without page-level horizontal overflow.
The equal-width wide slots remain schematic, while ASCII encoding slots are narrower. Controls and table columns fit their containers; no missing glyphs or blank diagrams were observed.
Dark captures retain a charcoal surface with pale text and rose controls/citations; light captures use warm paper, dark copy and the matching accent.

Full-page narrow captures are scaled when viewed as a whole. Legibility judgments also use actual CSS sizes, font/geometry checks and the complete DOM copy; this is not pixel-by-pixel reading of every glyph at physical-phone size.

Eight actual offline browser cases exercised pointer and keyboard mechanism controls, language round trips, retained numeric totals, explicit theme overrides and reduced-motion behavior, with no console/page errors or automatic external requests.
limitations: Full-page visual observations are composition-level; no physical-phone, screen-reader or exhaustive accessibility acceptance was performed.
Agent translation/editorial review is not independent human translation review or human comprehension evidence.
The chosen diagram states are illustrative navigation, not execution of CPython or Docker or a geographic experiment.
